newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian June industrial turnover down 7.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italian June industrial turnover down 7.5 pct.

text.p: 7.5 percent year-on-year in June, while orders fell 15.4
percent, national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Year on year change -7.5 pct -2.8 pct +21.7 pct
Year on year change -15.4 pct -5.8 pct +21.0 pct
Notes: Istat said the fall in turnover was spread throughout most sectors with the exception of industrial machinery which rose 5.1 percent, and electrical and optical goods which rose 4.8 percent.
Falls in orders were seen in most sectors with the transport sector falling 38.6 percent, the paper sector down 20.8 percent and the metals sector down 20.6 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
